description: US FAA aircraft registry record for an N-number: serial, status, manufacturer, model, year, certificate and expiry dates, registered owner and address. Public FAA inquiry page; the FAA says the data is not for airworthiness decisions. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: gov_faa_aircraft_registry
title: Gov Faa Aircraft Registry
